title: Patna High Court Assistant Group C Exam Date 2026
organization: High Court of Judicature at Patna
qualification: Bachelor Degree in any stream from a recognized university in India and a six-month computer diploma or certificate
ageLimit: 18 to 37 years for male candidates and up to 40 years for female candidates as on 01/01/2026; relaxation as per rules
applicationFee: General / BC / EBC / EWS: Rs. 1500; SC / ST / PH: Rs. 750
selectionProcess: Written Examination -> Document Verification -> Further stages as notified by Patna High Court
documentsRequired: Registration credentials, printed admit card, application details and original photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://patnahighcourt.gov.in
2. Open the Assistant Group C exam notice or admit card link
3. Log in through the official recruitment portal when the admit card is activated
4. Download and print the admit card
5. Carry the printed admit card and valid photo ID to the examination centre
shortDescription: Patna High Court Assistant Group C Exam Date 2026 for 68 posts. The written examination is scheduled for 18 September 2026.
content:
High Court of Judicature at Patna has released the exam schedule update for the Ex-Cadre Assistant Group C Recruitment 2026 under notice PHC/03/2026.

The recruitment includes 68 Assistant posts. The written examination is scheduled for 18 September 2026. Candidates should download the official exam notice and check the Patna High Court portal for admit-card availability.

Exam instructions

  • Reach the centre according to the reporting time printed on the admit card.
  • Carry the printed admit card and original valid photo ID.
  • Follow the centre, shift and examination instructions in the official notice.
